title: Troubleshooting Frontmatter Schema
description: Schema for validating maintainer troubleshooting YAML frontmatter in .agents/docs/troubleshooting/*.md

id.description: Stable slug, must match the filename without .md. Unique within this folder.

description.description: One or two sentences summarizing the entry.

tags.description: Non-empty list of lowercase [a-z0-9_-] topic labels.

depends_on.description: Qualified references to other durable entries.

status.description: Lifecycle status; troubleshooting entries may be marked as obsolete when no longer relevant.
